verdict.rationale: Autumn's attach endpoint handles new subscriptions and upgrades and runs on Stripe, and it can open a hosted billing portal session for existing customers. That suggests payment collection is delegated to Stripe rather than a custom UI, but no item explicitly documents a redirect to a hosted checkout page. Missing for 10: explicit docs of a hosted checkout URL or redirect flow from attach, any conversion-optimization claims, and hands-on or independent confirmation of the checkout experience.
